questions.stem: At equilibrium, the concentration of reactant A is 0.3 M and product B is 0.7 M. What will happen to these concentrations over time if conditions remain constant?

options.text: The concentrations will remain at 0.3 M and 0.7 M respectively
Both concentrations will gradually decrease to zero
The concentration of A will increase and B will decrease until they are equal

questions.explanation: At equilibrium, concentrations are constant (not changing) as long as conditions remain the same. They do not need to be equal. The concentrations will remain at 0.3 M and 0.7 M because the forward and reverse reactions are proceeding at equal rates, so there is no net change.
